description: This source file defines the class CachedCatalogViewModelService, which implements caching for catalog view model services in an e-commerce web application. It utilizes IMemoryCache to cache results of methods fetching brands, types, and catalog items.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that adds caching behavior to catalog view model data retrieval, implementing ICatalogViewModelService.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves brand list, utilizing cache to improve performance.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog items, supporting pagination and filtering, with caching.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves product types, utilizing cache for efficiency.
